pages.title: Desert Dangers
pages.text: The desert harbors many threats. These creatures attack on sight and can overwhelm the unprepared.$(br2)$(warning)Travel with weapons ready and keep an eye on your surroundings.

pages.name: Scarab Beetle
pages.text: Ancient beetles that swarm from tombs. Drop $(item)Scarab Shell$() fragments.

pages.name: Locus
pages.text: Desert locusts that devour crops and attack travelers. Often found in swarms.

pages.title: Combat Tips
pages.text: $(li)Scarabs are weak individually$(li)Locusts are fast but fragile$(li)Use area attacks against swarms$(li)Fire is effective$(li)$(item)Staff of Ra$() excels here
